keyPoints: Kishoravastha (adolescence) lagbhag 11 se 19 saal tak ka jeevan kaal hai jisme sharir aur man dono tezi se badalte hain.
Is dauran sharir me hormone naam ke rasayan badlav laate hain — ladkon ki aawaz bhari hoti hai aur daadhi-moonchh aati hai, ladkiyon me mahwari shuru hoti hai.
Lambai tezi se badhti hai, vajan badhta hai aur chehre par muhase nikal sakte hain — ye sab samanya, prakritik aur asthaayi badlav hain.
Dimag bhi badalta hai — naye vichar aate hain, sawal uthte hain aur kabhi-kabhi mood ka utarna-chadhna bhi samanya hai.
Santulit bhojan, roz khel-kood aur poori neend is umr me vishesh roop se zaroori hai kyunki sharir tezi se nirman kar raha hota hai.
Sharir ki safai, saaf kapde aur swachh aadataen apnana kishoravastha me sehat ki majboot neenv daalta hai.
Aam galti: in badlavon se ghabrana ya sharmana; ye prakritik hai, har kisi me alag gati se hote hain aur inpar khulkar baat karni chahiye.
